pages.text: Ancient villager legends speaks of giant hoglin-like creatures that shoot Magma Cubes at their foes, leaving devastation. Inspired and with some tinkering, you've made a focus that shoots out a ball of magma that leaves an explosion... and a couple of loyal Magma Cubes at the site of impact.
Casting with $(l:crafts/staff/nether_staff)Nether Staff$() increases explosion range.
